mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, public_id, external_observation_id, observed_at, rainfall_24h_mm, water_level_over_warning_m, max_water_depth_m, affected_area_km2, affected_population, trapped_population, evacuated_population, vulnerable_population, injured_population, missing_population, death_population, damaged_households, collapsed_houses, road_interruptions, critical_facilities_affected, power_outage_households FROM disaster_event_observation WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND ((#{externalObservationId} IS NOT NULL AND external_observation_id = #{externalObservationId}) OR observed_at = #{observedAt}) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
